about: Cards and chassis as the OLS Introduction deck (docs/internal/OLS Introduction 20260419.pdf, git-ignored; `page` its PDF pages) draws them, kept by hand: the IIVI syncs never write this file. `image` is the deck’s picture of the front, under public/, `size` its pixels, and `ports` where each of the card’s optical ports is on it, as [x, y, width, height]: `box` its connector (a duplex LC or MPO, Tx the left half and Rx the right, OUT then IN as the fronts print them; or a cage), or `tx` and `rx` where they sit apart. A port of the card not listed is inside it; one with only a `tx` is an output alone (a monitor tap). `like` takes another card’s picture and ports (and specs, unless it has its own). `slots` are where a chassis’s slots are on its picture.

lc-c925.name: TMUX-C9-25
lc-c925.about: Terminal mux with amplifiers (generic R2.9): a twin 9-degree WSS, a boost and a pre-amplifier, OCM, OTDR and OSC on one card. Its OSC, amplifier ports (BAIN, LINEIN, LINEOUT, PAOUT) and the WSS’s logical COM port are inside it, so only LINE, A/D1–A/D9 and MON 1/2 are on its front.

specs.Front: LINE, A/D1–A/D9 (DLC) and MON 1/2: one DLC, MON1 the LINE OUT test point, MON2 the LINE IN one after the pre-amp, both −19 dB
specs.Pre-amp (PA): 15–25 dB gain, 21 dBm out, a 0–25 dB VOA before it
specs.WSS: twin 9-degree, 6.25 GHz centre grid, 12.5 GHz bandwidth steps, up to 15 dB per channel
specs.OSC: GE at 1510 nm, 28 dB dynamic range
specs.Span: up to 25 dB attenuation adjustment; auto span loss measurement and ingress adaptation; auto channel power control

lc-tmuxc935.name: TMUX-C9-35
lc-tmuxc935.about: The TMUX-C9-25 with a 35 dB pre-amplifier and an amplified DWDM OSC (generic R2.9.100). The same front: LINE, A/D1–A/D9 and MON 1/2.

specs.Front: LINE, A/D1–A/D9 (DLC) and MON 1/2: one DLC, MON1 the LINE OUT test point, MON2 the LINE IN one after the pre-amp, both −19 dB
specs.Pre-amp (PA): 22–35 dB gain, 21 dBm out, a 0–25 dB VOA before it
specs.WSS: twin 9-degree, 6.25 GHz centre grid, 12.5 GHz bandwidth steps, up to 15 dB per channel
specs.OSC: 100M DWDM at 191.2 THz (1567.95 nm), 45 dB dynamic range, amplified by the pre-amp; 3 dB more loss before the OSC Rx in the official release
specs.LEDs: STAT, one per LINE and A/D port

lc-c25.name: TMUX-C-25
lc-c25.about: Terminal amplifier with no WSS (generic R2.9.100): a boost and a pre-amplifier, OCM and OSC. SIG takes the whole band in and out; the OSC is inside the card.

specs.Front: LINE and SIG (DLC), MON 1/2: one DLC, MON1 the LINE OUT test point, MON2 the LINE IN one after the pre-amp, both −19 dB
specs.Pre-amp (PA): 15–25 dB gain, 21 dBm out, a 0–25 dB VOA before it
specs.OSC: GE at 1510 nm, 28 dB dynamic range
specs.Span: up to 15 dB attenuation adjustment; auto span loss measurement and adaptation TBD
specs.LEDs: STAT, one per LINE and SIG

lc-400mx.name: 400MX-S (M4QD)
lc-400mx.about: 400G muxponder (generic R2.5 and R2.9): four 100GE clients into one 400G line. 400MX-S is a label sticker on the M4QD card.

specs.Front: L1 QSFP-DD cage (up to 25 W), C1–C4 QSFP28 cages (up to 7.2 W): C1 over C2, C3 over C4
specs.Data path: 4×100GE ↔ 400G-16QAM OpenZR+ SS (OPMODE 102), through a gearbox (4×CAUI-4 or OTL4.4 ↔ 4×100GAUI-2)
specs.Functions: temperature, optical and coherent PM; line and client loopback; NTA upgrade of the card and DCO; 3rd-party pluggables; latch graceful shutdown; line 400G PRBS BERT

specs.Front: 10 QSFP-DD800 cages, 1–5 over 6–10, each a line or a client port
specs.Line DCO: QSFP-DD800 FTCE3326R1PCL (max 32 W): 800G 123.8 GBd mPCS SDFEC, 600G 118 GBd 8QAM, 400G 118 GBd QPSK OFEC ZR+, 400G 80 GBd 8QAM OFEC ZR+, 400G 85 GBd 16QAM-PS OFEC ZR+ (TBD)
specs.Clients: QSFP-DD800 800GE (800GAUI-8, DR8 later), QSFP-DD 400GE (400GAUI-8: FR4), QSFP28 100GE (CAUI-4: CWDM4, LR4)
specs.Service modes: 8×100GE and 2×400GE ↔ 800G: OPMODE 140; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ ITU400-16QAMPS-85G-SDFEC: OPMODE 105; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ ZR400G-OFEC-QPSK: OPMODE 103; 6×100GE ↔ ZR600G-OFEC-8QAM: OPMODE 150
specs.Inside: two Microchip META-DX2+ PM6214 gearboxes with OTN
specs.LEDs: 11 RGB: card status/power, one per port
specs.Environment: −5 to 45 °C at sea level, 5–85 % RH, 40 °C with one fan failed

lc-t1x12c8.name: T1X12C8 (T1XC128)
lc-t1x12c8.about: Tencent OPC8 1200G muxponder, the same card as Polaris L1X12C8: the line module (CIM8) at L1 and eight client cages.

specs.Front: L1 the line, its Tx over its Rx; client cages C1, C3, C5, C7 over C2, C4, C6, C8
specs.Client cages: C1, C2, C7, C8 QSFP112 (400GE, takes QSFP56/28); C3–C6 QSFP56 (200GE, takes QSFP28); C1–C4 on PHY1, C5–C8 on PHY2
specs.Service modes: 8×100GE and 2×400GE ↔ 800G: OPMODE 54; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ 400G-16QAMPS-90G-SDFEC: OPMODE 55; ↔ 400G-16QAMPS-128G-SDFEC: OPMODE 56; 6×100GE ↔ 600G-16QAMPS-138G-SDFEC: OPMODE 57
specs.Line Tx: max 10 dBm in C band, 8 dBm in L band
specs.LEDs: card status, line port, one per client port
specs.Functions: CRS and SNC service models, TTI, LLDP, test signal, loopback, SNCP, OCH 1+1 with SD, telemetry

lc-op3.name: OP3
lc-op3.about: Tencent OPC8 OCH 1+1 protection, C and L band: three protection units, each A and B protecting SIG; also protection assisted by the electrical layer.

specs.Front: 1A 1B over 1SIG, 2A 2B over 2SIG, 3A 3B over 3SIG (DLP LC, no shutter)
specs.LEDs: card, primary, secondary and common port status

lc-awcl.name: AWCL
lc-awcl.about: Tencent OPC8 C+L ROADM, 4 slots: C and L pre-amps and boosters, a 2×2×32 C&L WSS (its 33rd port adds ASE), HR-OCM and ASE per band, OTDR, OSC and an intra-node SFP. EXT1 and EXT2 are RJ-45s for the extension shelf (with 12 V), not fibers.

specs.Front: LINE, EXP1–EXP8, AUX (Coherent probe or OSA) DLP LC; EMUX1–EMUX3 MPO-24 (24 add/drop); MF MPO-12 (Back-C/L, ASE-C/L, OCM-C/L); EXT1, EXT2 RJ-45
specs.Pre-amps: PA-SWG-C and PA-SWG-L, 24 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.Boosters: BA-VGA-C 24 dBm and BA-VGA-L 23 dBm with output VOA, 14–22 dB (22–25 extended)
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 2 fibers
specs.OSC: 1625 nm, 35 dB dynamic range; intra-node SFP 1GbE at 191.2 THz
specs.ASE filling: band level, fast, on line-input LOS (under 5 ms typical, 10 ms max); channel level through the WSS 33rd add port; force, auto, revertive with WTR, hold-off

lc-ilae-swg-cl.name: ILAE-SWG-CL
lc-ilae-swg-cl.about: Tencent OPC8 C&L inline amplifier, 2 slots: an amplifier per band and direction, an HR-OCM per band, OTDR and two OSCs.

specs.Front: LINEA, LINEB, AUX (DLP LC); OSCA and OSCB SFP cages
specs.Amplifiers: 2×ILA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 2×ILA-SWG-L 23 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 40 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers
specs.LEDs: card, AUX, line A and B

lc-ila-swg-cl.name: ILA-SWG-CL
lc-ila-swg-cl.about: Tencent OPC8 C&L inline amplifier, 2 slots: the ILAE-SWG-CL with internal middle-stage access for gain equalisation (a 2 dB GFF middle stage).

specs.Front: LINEA, LINEB, AUX (DLP LC); OSCA and OSCB SFP cages
specs.Amplifiers: 2×ILA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 2×ILA-SWG-L 23 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 40 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers
specs.LEDs: card, AUX, line A and B

lc-fga.name: FGA
lc-fga.about: Tencent: a fixed-gain amplifier, 1 slot: a 10 dB add amplifier, then a 0–15 dB VOA, 18 dBm out at LINE. It lets an OPC8 C+L system carry OLS1000 T2X4C8 traffic (64 × 75 GHz from a MUX64 into the AWCL).

specs.Front: LINE and SIG (inner-shutter DLC)
specs.Monitors: SIG in, amplifier out, LINE in and out

lc-t1x8c8.name: T1X8C8
lc-t1x8c8.about: Tencent R3.2.0 800G muxponder: the integrated DCO line at L1 and eight client cages, odd ones on top; two Marvell x9340P gearboxes.

specs.Front: L1 the line, its Tx over its Rx; cages 1, 3, 5, 7 over 2, 4, 6, 8: QSFP-DD at 1 and 7 (8 SerDes) and 2 and 8 (4), QSFP28 at 3–6 (4)
specs.Service modes: 8×100GE, 2×400GE ↔ ITU800G-16QAMPS-132G-OFEC (1×800GE, 4×200GE later); 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ ITU400G-16QAMPS-90G-OFEC or ITU400G-16QAMPS-120G-SDFEC
specs.LEDs: 10 (sticker): card status/power, line, one per client
specs.Environment: −5 to 45 °C at 1800 ft, 5–85 % RH, −40 to 85 °C stored

lc-lch08.name: LCH08
lc-lch08.about: Tencent POLS (R3.100.0, IPoDWDM with 800G Coherent Lite DCOs, 1.6T later): eight cages, 1–4 over 5–8.

specs.Front: cages 1–4 over 5–8, heat sinks between the rows

lc-dgecl.name: DGE-CL
lc-dgecl.about: Polaris C+L inline amplifier with DGE, 4 slots (the AWCL board): an amplifier per band and direction, twin C and twin L DGE, an HR-OCM per band, OTDR and two OSCs. AUX is on its front but not in its port list.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST, AUX (DLP LC); EXT1, EXT2 RJ-45 and the extension connector (12 V)
specs.Amplifiers: 2×ILA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 2×ILA-SWG-L 23 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 40 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers
specs.LEDs: card, AUX, line A and B

lc-olp3-3.name: OLP3-3
lc-olp3-3.about: Polaris OCH protection, C and L band: three 1+2 units, A, B and C protecting SIG; under 50 ms; absolute or relative switch, revertive or not, hold-off, commands; SF/SD from optical power or the L1 card’s diagnosis.

specs.Front: 1A 1B over 1C 1SIG, 2A 2B over 2C 2SIG, 3A 3B over 3C 3SIG (12 DLC)
specs.LEDs: RGB, one per LC port, and card status

lc-iracl.name: IRA-CL
lc-iracl.about: Polaris C+L ROADM, 4 slots: the AWCL board renamed and recoloured, the same optics. AUX and MF are on its front but not in its port list; its EXP33 and SIG ports are inside the card.

specs.Front: LINE, EXP1–EXP8, AUX (DLC); MPO1 (9~16), MPO2 (17~24), MPO3 (25~32), MF (MPO); EXT1, EXT2 RJ-45 with 12 V for the extension shelf
specs.Cascade: a second IRA-CL’s LINE into the first one’s EXP (EXP8 by default), with two MUXPANEL-32C32L, for up to 63C + 63L add/drop

lc-ilacl.name: ILA-CL
lc-ilacl.about: Polaris C+L inline amplifier, 2 slots: the ILA-SWG-CL board renamed and recoloured, MF removed, the same optics. AUX is on its front but not in its port list.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST, AUX (DLP LC); OSCE and OSCW SFP cages

lc-ramancl-16.name: RAMAN-CL-16
lc-ramancl-16.about: Polaris C+L backward Raman pump, 1 slot (PN 60G410001), with its own OSC; a pair per span, or one at an OTM or ROADM.

specs.Front: LINE (toward the span), SIG (to the amplifier)
specs.Gain: 10–17 dB in 0.1 dB steps, spans up to 42 dB
specs.OSC: 191.15 THz (1568.36 nm) DWDM, 100FX, at least 44 dB port to port, in the pump’s direction
specs.Laser safety: APSD on the line (the Raman APSD triggers the amplifier’s), APR on LINE in and SIG out

lc-tmuxc64.name: TMUX-C64
lc-tmuxc64.about: Polaris C band flex-grid mux/demux, 4 slots: two 2×32 WSS; a 1×2 switch and a 50/50 coupler from A/B into the WSS COM ports, a 2×2 50/50 coupler back out to A/B. Its SIG port is inside the card.

specs.Front: A and B (inner-shutter DLP LC); MPO1–MPO8 (channels 1–8 to 57–64)

lc-tmuxc-32.name: TMUX-C-32
lc-tmuxc-32.about: Polaris C band terminal amplifier, 2 slots: the ILA-CL with its L band and the SIG-side OSC taken out.

specs.Front: SIG, LINE, AUX (inner-shutter DLP LC); the OSC SFP cage
specs.Pre-amp: PA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.Booster: BA-SWG-C 24 dBm with output VOA, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 2 fibers

lc-iladc-32.name: ILAD-C-32
lc-iladc-32.about: Polaris C band inline amplifier, 2 slots: the ILA-CL with its L band taken out.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST, AUX (inner-shutter DLP LC); OSCE and OSCW SFP cages
specs.Amplifiers: 2 × C band 24 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers

lc-iladc-dge-32.name: ILAD-C-DGE-32
lc-iladc-dge-32.about: Polaris C band inline amplifier with twin DGE, 4 slots: the DGE-CL with its L band taken out.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST, AUX (inner-shutter DLP LC); EXT1, EXT2 RJ-45
specs.Amplifiers: 2×ILA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 40 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers

lc-tmuxc32-32.name: TMUX-C32-32
lc-tmuxc32-32.about: Polaris C band ROADM, 4 slots: the IRA-CL with its L band and ASE taken out. AUX is on its front but not in its port list; its EXP33 and SIG are inside the card.

specs.Front: LINE, EXP1–EXP8, AUX (inner-shutter DLP LC); MPO1–MPO3 (24 add/drop); EXT1, EXT2 RJ-45
specs.Pre-amp: PA-SWG-C 24 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.Booster: BA-VGA-C 24 dBm with output VOA, 14–22 dB (22–25 extended)
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 2 fibers

lc-olp3.name: OLP3
lc-olp3.about: Polaris C band OCH protection: three 1+1 units, A and B protecting SIG; the OLP3-3 with port C, its LED and its PD taken out and a 50:50 coupler in, so the protection state machine always keeps alternate 2 locked out.

specs.Front: 1A 1B over 1SIG, 2A 2B over 2SIG, 3A 3B over 3SIG (9 DLC)

lc-l1x12c8.name: L1X12C8 (L1X12C8-L)
lc-l1x12c8.about: Polaris 1200G muxponder, C band (L1X12C8-L for L band); clients 1–8 mux into line port 1.

specs.Front: L1 the line, its Tx over its Rx; client cages C1, C3, C5, C7 over C2, C4, C6, C8
specs.Client cages: C1, C2, C7, C8 QSFP112 (400GE, takes QSFP56/28); C3–C6 QSFP56 (200GE, takes QSFP28); C1–C4 on PHY1, C5–C8 on PHY2
specs.Service modes: 8×100GE and 2×400GE ↔ 800G: OPMODE 54; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ 400G-16QAMPS-90G-SDFEC: OPMODE 55; ↔ 400G-16QAMPS-128G-SDFEC: OPMODE 56; 6×100GE ↔ 600G-16QAMPS-138G-SDFEC: OPMODE 57
specs.Line Tx: max 10 dBm in C band, 8 dBm in L band
specs.LEDs: card status, line port, one per client port

lc-l3x8c7.name: L3X8C7
lc-l3x8c7.about: Polaris 800G muxponder, transponder and regenerator: the deck describes it as the 800MX, with the same faceplate (label COHR-RL3X8C7_Flex).

specs.Front: 10 QSFP-DD800 cages, 1–5 over 6–10, each a line or a client port
specs.Line DCO: QSFP-DD800 FTCE3326R1PCL (max 32 W): 800G 123.8 GBd mPCS SDFEC, 600G 118 GBd 8QAM, 400G 118 GBd QPSK OFEC ZR+, 400G 80 GBd 8QAM OFEC ZR+, 400G 85 GBd 16QAM-PS OFEC ZR+ (TBD)
specs.Clients: QSFP-DD800 800GE (800GAUI-8, DR8 later), QSFP-DD 400GE (400GAUI-8: FR4), QSFP28 100GE (CAUI-4: CWDM4, LR4)
specs.Service modes: 8×100GE and 2×400GE ↔ 800G: OPMODE 140; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ ITU400-16QAMPS-85G-SDFEC: OPMODE 105; 4×100GE or 400GE ↔ ZR400G-OFEC-QPSK: OPMODE 103; 6×100GE ↔ ZR600G-OFEC-8QAM: OPMODE 150
specs.Inside: two Microchip META-DX2+ PM6214 gearboxes with OTN
specs.LEDs: 11 RGB: card status/power, one per port
specs.Environment: −5 to 45 °C at sea level, 5–85 % RH, 40 °C with one fan failed

lc-fmux-32.name: FMUX_32
lc-fmux-32.about: Polaris BONE 2.0 C band 32-channel flex-grid mux/demux, 2 slots: 0–15 dB per channel per direction; SIGA and SIGB through a 2×2 coupler extend it to 64 channels with 1+1 protection over COM1 and COM2. Its EXP33, the WSS COM3 loopback for link discovery, is inside the card.

specs.Front: SIGA, SIGB, COM1, COM2, SIG (DLC); MPO1–MPO4 (channels 1–8 to 25–32)
specs.Grid: 6.25 GHz centre, 12.5 GHz steps, 50–500 GHz channels
specs.Loss: up 4.5 dB, drop 5.5 dB, through the WSS 9.5 dB
specs.SFP: one DWDM SFP (191.2 THz TBD) toward SIG
specs.Monitors: SIG and COM in and out, the WSS COM3 loopback; channel power at SIG by HR-OCM or UWB OCM

lc-ira-32.name: IRA_32
lc-ira-32.about: Polaris BONE 2.0 C band ROADM, 4 slots: pre-amp and booster at 24.5 dBm, an ASE source (19 dBm into the WSS), a 2×32 WSS, HR or UWB OCM, OTDR, OSC and a DWDM SFP toward the EXP ports. Its EXP33 and SIG are inside the card.

specs.Front: LINE, EXP1–EXP8 (inner-shutter DLP LC); MPO1–MPO3 (24 add/drop)
specs.Pre-amp: PA-SWG-C 24.5 dBm, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.Booster: BA-VGA-C 24.5 dBm with output VOA, 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended)
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 2 fibers

lc-tila.name: TILA
lc-tila.about: Polaris BONE 2.0 C band terminal or inline amplifier, 2 slots: two amplifiers at 24.5 dBm, HR or UWB OCM, OTDR and two OSCs; as a terminal amplifier its LINE_WEST APSD and OSC are off.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST (inner-shutter DLP LC)
specs.Amplifiers: 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 38 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers

lc-dge.name: DGE
lc-dge.about: Polaris BONE 2.0 C band inline amplifier with twin DGE, 4 slots: two ILA-SWG-C at 24.5 dBm with output VOA, HR-OCM, OTDR and two OSCs.

specs.Front: LINE_WEST, LINE_EAST (inner-shutter DLP LC)
specs.Amplifiers: 10–20 dB (20–24 extended), 18–28 dB (28–32 extended), 0–15 dB output VOA
specs.OTDR: 1630–1650 nm, 40 dB dynamic range, switched to 4 fibers

lc-m4qd.name: M4QD
lc-m4qd.about: The 400MX-S card under its own name: the deck’s picture of it is labelled M4QD.

lc-800mx-sec.name: 800MX_MACSEC
lc-800mx-sec.about: The 800MX with MACsec, client to line, at 100GE, 400GE and 800GE (generic R2.9.200). The deck draws it with the 800MX faceplate.

specs.Front: 10 QSFP/QSFP-DD cages, 1–5 over 6–10
specs.MACsec: IEEE 802.1AE-2018, 802.1AEbn-2011 (256-bit key), 802.1AEbw-2013 (XPN); GCM-AES-128/256 and GCM-AES-XPN-128/256; up to 2048 SecYs, 2048 SCs and 4096 SAs per direction; global, static per-channel and inline bypass; NIST FIPS-197 CAVP A6777
